zh-Hans: 让你见识高桥凉介亲传，真正的最快理论！
en: I'll show you the real fastest theory, straight from Ryosuke Takahashi!
Time to end this! I can't keep playing around with you!
You're not getting away! I'll catch you!
I'm not letting you get away!

zh-Hans: 他的动作从刚才起就一点点变得不稳，他也累了！
en: His movements have been getting shakier. He's getting tired too!

zh-Hans: 太嫩了，我已经看穿你的弱点！
en: Not good enough! I've seen your weakness!

zh-Hans: 看来多少懂点计时赛压缩时间的道理。
en: He knows a thing or two about shaving time in a time attack.
Don't rush. Don't get worked up.

zh-Hans: 别头脑发热，光凭气势踩油门是行不通的！
en: Don't lose your head. There's more to throttle control than sheer guts!

zh-Hans: 搞不懂，是我状态差得离谱，还是调校出了问题？
en: I don't get it. Am I that far off my game, or did I get the setup wrong?

zh-Hans: 真像，跟我以前的跑法一模一样。斗志外露，咄咄逼人。
en: He reminds me of myself. The way I used to drive. Raw fighting spirit, pure aggression.

zh-Hans: 你确实不慢，不过也没你自己以为的那么快！
en: You're not slow, but you're not as fast as you think!

zh-Hans: 我在理论派老哥手底下受的磨炼，可不是白受的！
en: All that drilling from my theory-obsessed brother wasn't for nothing!

zh-Hans: 直道尾速能拉到多高，很大程度取决于前一个弯怎么出！
en: How much speed you build on a straight depends a lot on how you exit the corner before it!

zh-Hans: 每个弯都用同样的方法攻，可不行！
en: You can't attack every corner the same way!

zh-Hans: 我就按我的方法来！D 的王牌是我！
en: I'll do it my way! I'm D's ace!

zh-Hans: 让你看看，我跟以前可不只是变了一点点！
en: I'll show you just how much I've changed!
